summary: First test run. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (fees, admin gate, withdraw/swap quotes, deposit addresses, full funded flow adjust->transfer->check claim->swap(+409 on min_receive)->invoice pay->history kinds->debit back, finance 7/30/90, cold invalid address 400, hot-wallet, settings, recreate addresses). Bot modules import OK; fees TON 0.05 / USDT_TON 0.4 / USDT_TRC20 2.8 (5.1 new addr). Security: nosniff present, 429 after ~180 req/min. Frontend: /app compiles (no babel overlay), outside TG shows 'Кошелёк живёт внутри Telegram'; with signed initData Home renders 8 equal tiles (84x80 mobile, 107x80 desktop, no horizontal overflow); deposit ton/tron + TRC20 fee hint; withdraw fee 0.05 TON (not submitted); swap 10 TON -> 10.5138 USDT quote; settings recreate addresses toast; delete flow on 900000099 works. Admin: /admin 404 page, hidden path login with email+password+OTP, Finance cards+day switch, Hot wallet topup with 2 addresses+2 QR, cold save validation error 'Некорректный адрес TON', Settings toggles + save, mobile admin nav. Public site: all 5 pages, fees-table from /api/fees, api-endpoints, nav + mobile menu, no admin login mention. One security bug found (X-Forwarded-For spoof bypasses rate limits).

critical.issue: Rate limit keyed on FIRST X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. Reproduced: after hitting 429 on /api/fees, same client with header 'X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.79' got 200 immediately. Attacker can bypass the 10/min admin-auth and /api/p/ panel-key brute-force limits and the 180/min API limit by rotating the header. Fix: use the LAST (ingress-appended) hop / trusted proxy count, not fwd.split(',')[0].

minor.issue: direction not validated: any value other than 'credit' is treated as debit; asset not validated against ASSETS (unknown asset -> likely 500 from to_units).
Rejects deposit addresses but NOT the hot wallet address itself (UQBIHObl... can be saved as cold -> cold transfers to self). Non-numeric max_pct/target_pct -> float() ValueError 500 instead of 400.

After deletion, next mini-app login (upsert_tg_user) re-writes username/first_name, undoing the anonymisation; deleted user sees only generic 'Аккаунт заморожен' banner and Settings still shows 'Удалить аккаунт' button (would return 'Аккаунт уже удалён'). Consider blocking/marking deleted users in auth and showing a 'deleted' state.
Cross-network USDT_TON <-> USDT_TRC20 swap allowed at 1:1 (fees page says only 'Обмен TON ↔ USDT') — confirm intended; moves liability between chains' hot wallets.

ui_bugs.issue: Possible race: in one run the typed value 'abc' was overwritten and the form saved the original (empty) config with toast 'Сохранено'; on retry (after waiting 3s) it behaved correctly. useEffect(setC(data.cold)) on late/second settings load can clobber user input. Low priority.
'Обменять' (swap-submit-button) enabled with 'Доступно: 0 TON' and amount > balance; error only after server call. Consider disabling/inline hint.

action_items: HIGH: fix client_ip in security.py so X-Forwarded-For cannot be spoofed to bypass rate limits (use rightmost/trusted hop).
Validate direction in ('credit','debit') and asset in ASSETS for admin adjust.
PUT /cold: reject hot wallet addresses; return 400 for non-numeric pct.
Handle deleted accounts on re-login (don't restore username; show deleted state; hide delete button).
Minor: guard cold form against state reset after user edits; disable swap submit when amount > available.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py client_ip trusts client-supplied first XFF hop (see critical).
OTP_DEBUG_LOG=true prints admin OTP to logs — must be disabled before production (already noted in creds file).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; 2 low-priority UX issues)
